notes: This is a Christmas/holiday-themed entry in the popular 'There Was an Old Lady Who Swallowed...' series. The cumulative swallowing structure is highly repetitive and predictable, making it excellent for AAC use. Key interaction points are naming each swallowed object and anticipating what comes next. 'Tummy' is included as a core story concept since the old lady's belly grows with each swallow. Consider adding visual cues for the cumulative sequence. Author is listed as Unknown but the series is commonly attributed to Lucille Colandro.
